eval_awareness_probe.note: AUROC=1.0 is partly trivial: the free/paid tier is stated explicitly in the prompt (is_free_tier_user tag), so tier is near-tautologically decodable. The meaningful result is that the SEPARATION MAGNITUDE persists across frames.

conclusion: Frames change output behavior, not the internal representation of tier: the free/paid eval-awareness direction is perfectly decodable at layer 27 and its magnitude barely drops under any frame (Cohen's d ~14-18 across all), even though the behavioral compliance gap collapses to ~0. Geometrically the eschatological frame (F3) shifts the last-token representation most from no-frame, but that larger representational shift does not produce a larger behavioral effect than the secular frames.
